description: Agent Uncertainty: submit the assumptions under one result: optionally the result with its statement and its text as delivered, read for assumption wording such as assuming, presumably, given that or all else equal; and each assumption the result lists with its id, the assumption as written, whether the result changes if it fails, whether the result flags it as load-bearing, what changes in the result if it fails and whether it was checked before the result was given. The signed report gives the result with the assumption wording read from it, every assumption with its status as disclosed, unflagged, impact_unstated, unchecked, vague, not_load_bearing or unconfirmed, and counts the load-bearing, flagged, checked assumptions and those with a stated consequence of failure, and names a result that hides what it assumes: assumption wording in the result with no assumptions listed, an assumption the result changes with left unflagged as load-bearing, and a load-bearing assumption that says nothing about what changes if it fails; then a load-bearing assumption never checked and an assumption stated too loosely to check, such as normal conditions or business as usual, with the fix for each. This reads the assumptions under a result an agent gives, not an evaluation’s design or a knowledge base’s sources: the design of a formal evaluation is wever_evaluation-design-check, and the sources behind the facts in a knowledge base are wever_knowledge-source-check. Verdict assumptions_hidden, assumption_disclosure_gaps, assumption_disclosure_unverified or assumptions_disclosed. POST /api/uncertainty-assumption-check. Reads only the recorded work product and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no answer is changed, no source is fetched and no party is contacted. Agent Uncertainty reads the uncertainty an agent carries in its own work products and answers, its stated confidence, what it does not know and what it assumed: it is not formal scoring of outputs against rubrics, datasets and benchmarks (the wever_evaluation checks), not grading the source material itself (wever_claim-evidence-check, wever_data-evidence-check and the other evidence checks), not traces, metrics and runtime behavior (the wever_observability checks) and not the loop around feedback received (the wever_feedback checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-uncertainty-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-uncertainty/.

changes_result.description: The result changes if this assumption fails.

checked.description: It was checked before the result was given.

flagged.description: The result marks it as load-bearing.

id.description: The assumption id, such as a1.

if_fails.description: What changes in the result if it fails.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

statement.description: The result, such as ship date 12 March.

text.description: The result as delivered, read for assumption wording such as assuming or presumably.

name: wever_uncertainty-assumption-check
title: Uncertainty assumption check
